bento.heading: Built for CodeMirror
bento.subheading: Deeply embedded in CodeMirror and works reliably as content changes line by line

items.answer: Yes. Velt anchors each comment to a range in the CodeMirror document and rebases that anchor as the surrounding code is edited. Comments stay attached to the right line even after multi-user edits, refactors, or formatting changes.
items.question: Will comments move as code changes?

items.answer: Yes. The comments package can be installed and used standalone, without enabling presence, cursors, or CRDT-backed multiplayer editing.
items.question: Can I add comments without multiplayer?

items.answer: No. Velt provides a fully managed collaboration backend for comments, presence, and persistence — no server to run.
items.question: Do I need backend infrastructure?

items.answer: Yes. Inline comments anchored to specific lines or ranges work well for code review and pair-programming workflows.
items.question: Is this suitable for code reviews?
